purpose: Separate live IADC current from background BMS average; test and reject a BATFET IRQ guard
overall: Experimental current observability improved; absolute accuracy, background-counter discrepancy, temperature/profile/capacity and final gauge policy remain open

current_source.current_now: IIO processed current, scaled1000 from standard milliamps to microamps; normal sample-cache refresh applies
current_source.current_avg: Background BMS VSENSE conversion, separate value/error
current_source.initialization_error: BMS configuration/charge error is used because the independent IADC read may succeed

checks.unchanged_helper_source_byte_comparison: PASS against35743f198 for math,snapshot/restart and sense/configuration functions
checks.UPower: Active; finite values and no critical warning in snapshot; incomplete measurement-only interface ignored, no capacity invented

bounded_response.interpretation: Both current sources respond under discharge; source measurements and counter share hardware/calibration and do not establish independent electrical accuracy.

BATFET_investigation.read_only_observer: 52 bytes/22 fixed reads, including charger RT,battery temperature/BATFET status and sample controls; no register writes or IRQ request
BATFET_investigation.native_precomparison: 10 USB-idle sets with raw BATFET reported open and manual/BMS near0; a later65-set discharge-to-USB-bypass run does not reproduce the large steady discrepancy
BATFET_investigation.stock_comparison: Six RAM-stock sets report Charging/Good and BATFET closed; no disk filesystems mounted. Operating state differs from native idle, so this is not a matched charging-stop comparison.
BATFET_investigation.guarded_polling_attempt: Counter unavailable/live-current branch test encounters raw FET state versus cached-property disagreement; no successful guard qualification claimed

controlled_variant_module.diagnostic_variant: IRQ acknowledge only, both workqueue polling sites disabled, IRQ configuration readback added

BATFET_investigation.conclusion: Automatic BMS polling and IRQ-triggered refresh are not necessary causes of the observed high rate. Electrical/controller cause remains unknown. Single raw-FET classification and this IRQ design are excluded from integration.

stock_control_API_audit.charging_enabled_0: Vendor setter both disables charging and forces operation on battery; cannot alone reproduce USB-powered idle isolation.
stock_control_API_audit.charge_only_candidate: Full pinned power_supply_sysfs.c maps factory bms/charge to at_chg_status_store -> chg_status_set(0); BMS factory property list exposes it. No force-run-on-battery. Runtime presence/writability and controlled stop/restart still untested.

limits: Independent current measurement was not performed; do not label either source electrical ground truth.
A background/current disagreement and counter trend do not alone establish its physical cause.
Current API response passes; complete gauge/capacity, temperature/charger policy and whole-cycle integration acceptance remain open.
No raw BATFET IRQ or isolation guard is shipped.
No repartition or upstream submission occurred.
